name: Agent Tool (MCP)
description: Connects an Agent Task's LLM to every tool exposed by an MCP server (tools/list is called once, each remote tool becomes a callable tool). This task is never run by the engine — it's read as config by the agent-task-worker. Place inside an Agent Task (ad hoc sub-process), alongside the Agent LLM Call task.

properties.label: Server Name
properties.description: Short identifier for this MCP server, used to prefix the tool names the LLM sees, e.g. fxrate → fxrate__get_rate.

pattern.message: Must be a valid identifier: letters, numbers, underscores, not starting with a number.

properties.label: Server URL
properties.description: Used when Transport is Remote (HTTP). The MCP server's JSON-RPC endpoint, e.g. https://api.example.com/mcp

properties.label: Headers (JSON)
properties.description: Optional JSON object of request headers, e.g. auth tokens. Only used when Transport is Remote (HTTP).

properties.label: Command
properties.description: Used when Transport is Local (stdio subprocess). The executable to spawn, e.g. node

properties.label: Command Arguments
properties.description: Space-separated arguments passed to Command, e.g. ./fx-rate-mcp/server.js
